positions.name: MeridianAnalyticsAdoption
positions.frame: what database platform is selected for the analytics pipeline and on what technical justification?
positions.why: Evaluation of ingestion capabilities identified critical gaps in Zypherion's streaming support, motivating an explicit operational switch to Meridian for both batch and streaming analytics and formally superseding the prior platform decision.

attaches.why: Reaffirms that the migration schedule and target kickoff window remain set for Q3 2026 despite the database engine replacement.
